```{r load-libraries}


# --- Load Libraries ---
# This section loads all the necessary R packages for data manipulation, visualization, and statistical analysis.
library(reshape2)     # data reshaping
library(ggplot2)      # Plotting
library(dplyr)        # Data manipulation
library(readr)        # Reading CSV files
library(readxl)       # Reading Excel files
library(ggpubr)       # Publication-ready plots
library(gridExtra)    # Arranging grid layouts
library(cowplot)      # Arranging plots
library(rstatix)      # Statistical tests
library(tidyr)        # Tidy data principles
# library(GGally)       # Advanced plots
library(ggbeeswarm)   # Beeswarm plots
library(plotly)       # Interactive plots
library(patchwork)    # Combining ggplot plots
# library(extrafont)    # Using custom fonts
library(writexl)      # Writing to Excel files
# library(lubridate)    # Date-time manipulation
# library(ggnewscale)   # Multiple color scales in ggplot
library(ggrepel)      # Repel overlapping text labels
library(data.table)
library(emmeans)      # Estimated marginal means
library(lme4)         # Linear mixed-effects models
library(lmerTest)     # Tests for lme4 models
library(viridis)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(stringr)
library(lme4)
library(ggnewscale)


# --- Custom Theme ---
# A custom ggplot theme is defined for consistent plot styling.
ct2 <- theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
        # text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.ticks.x.bottom = element_blank()) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16)) 

sessionInfo()
```
